title: Set up your business
subtitle: One workspace is one business. You can add details later; Kredibel will suggest them from your documents.
timeZoneHint: Months are counted in this time zone.
accountNumberHint: Only the last 4 digits are kept readable.
notReady: Your workspace was created, but this session has not caught up yet. Sign out and in again.

validation.accountNumber: Use 6 to 30 digits; spaces and dashes are fine.

trialRest: {{documents}} documents and {{pages}} pages a month. No card, no payment. Paid plans are coming soon.

industries.food-retail: Food and drink, cafes and restaurants

currencyHint: Reporting currency of your books (IDR, MYR, SGD, JPY, USD). Changing it later is coming soon.
frameworkHint: How cash flows are grouped on your dashboard. You can switch the view any time.

demo.title: Explore a demo company
demo.body: Sunrise Coffee Roasters: six months of a coffee roaster's synthetic books, already read twice and reconciled, with an edited statement, copies, a changed supplier account and unpaid bills. Nothing to upload; a guided tour shows the way.
demo.or: or set up your own business

welcome.title: What would you like Kredibel to do first?
welcome.subtitle: You can change this later in Settings. Either way, every document is read twice and every number keeps its source.

books.title: Keep my books
books.body: Reconcile bank statements, invoices, receipts and your ledger month by month, with one short review queue.

expect.title: Check what I expect
expect.body: Write the money in and out you expect for one or more months. Once your documents are read, see whether the books agree.

form.title: What you expect
form.hint: Leave a box empty if you do not know. Whole amounts in {{currency}}.
form.save: Save and go to my dashboard
form.invalid: Choose a month and write at least one amount as digits, e.g. 150000000.
